title: Running for a uniform
news: Thousands of Jharkhand women, many young mothers, ran trials in sarees and shorts for a few Home Guard posts, backed by husbands who coached them and families who minded children.
syllabus: Social influence and attitude change; Gender justice
link: Women's work needs a change of attitude at home as much as jobs outside; supportive husbands and families show how social influence can widen women's choices.
question: How can families and communities change attitudes that limit women's participation in paid work? Illustrate with examples.

title: Comparison as a loop
news: A mother of two teenagers writes how social media turns comparison into a loop of envy, and how to break it.
syllabus: Attitude: social influence and persuasion · Emotional intelligence · Role of family in inculcating values
link: Feeds that compare curated highlights with unfiltered lives shape attitudes; families that motivate by comparison pass the habit on, and self-awareness breaks the loop.
question: "Social media has turned comparison from an occasional act into a constant habit." Discuss its ethical implications and the role of family in building a healthy sense of self among the youth.

title: Manauli: change that spread by example
news: A Haryana village moved most of its land from paddy to sweet corn after one farmer copied a friend's success.
link: Attitudes changed through peer example and visible results, not through orders.
question: How can social influence and persuasion be used to change farmers' attitudes towards sustainable practices? Illustrate.
